title: TradeAC R&D Workflow YAML
description: JSON Schema for the bounded workflow document accepted by fina-builder's TradeAC R&D validator. Parse YAML to a JSON-compatible object before validating. Runtime providers, lake paths, credentials, Qlib initialization, and arbitrary Python classes are service-owned and must not be included.

experiment_name.description: Human-readable experiment identifier. Use letters, digits, spaces, dots, underscores, or hyphens; it must start with a letter or digit. Must match the experiment name entered in fina-builder.

task.description: The model, dataset/handler, and required analysis records for one R&D experiment.

model.description: Approved LightGBM-based model. The class and module_path must be used as one of the exact allowed pairs below.

class.description: Choose the standard Qlib LightGBM model or TradeAC RankIC model; the module_path must match the selected class.

module_path.description: Fixed module for the selected model class: LGBModel uses qlib.contrib.model.gbdt; RankICLGBModel uses tac_qlib.contrib.model.rank_gbdt.

kwargs.description: Optional model hyperparameter mapping; see modelKwargs for every supported property and its constraints.

class.description: Conditional check selecting the standard LGBModel variant.

module_path.description: Conditional fixed module required when class is LGBModel.

class.description: Conditional check selecting the TradeAC RankICLGBModel variant.

module_path.description: Conditional fixed module required when class is RankICLGBModel.

dataset.description: Qlib DatasetH wrapper containing the approved TACHandler and explicit train/validation/test date segments.

class.description: The only dataset class accepted by this workflow validator.

module_path.description: Fixed module for DatasetH; do not change.

kwargs.description: DatasetH settings. The handler describes data and preprocessing; segments define the three non-overlapping evaluation windows.

handler.description: Approved TACHandler configuration for lake bars and persisted features.

segments.description: Required inclusive train, valid, and test date ranges.

record.description: Records to produce. Include exactly one SignalRecord and one SigAnaRecord; PortAnaRecord is optional and may appear once. Record order is not significant.

class.description: Matches the required SignalRecord item in the record array.
Matches the required SigAnaRecord item in the record array.
Matches the optional PortAnaRecord item in the record array.

modelKwargs.description: Optional LightGBM parameters. Only the listed keys are accepted. Determinism fields are service-fixed: num_threads=1, deterministic=true, force_col_wise=true, and feature_fraction_seed/bagging_seed/data_random_seed must equal seed (default 2026).

n_estimators.description: Number of estimators when using the estimator-style LightGBM parameter.

early_stopping_rounds.description: Rounds without validation improvement before early stopping.

min_data_in_leaf.description: Minimum observations required in a leaf.

max_bin.description: Maximum number of bins used to bucket feature values.

min_child_samples.description: Minimum samples required in a leaf, using the LightGBM alias.

min_child_weight.description: Minimum sum of instance-weight/Hessian required in a leaf.

colsample_bytree.description: Fraction of columns sampled per tree, from 0.01 through 1.0.

subsample.description: Fraction of rows sampled for each boosting iteration, from 0.01 through 1.0.

subsample_freq.description: Frequency of row subsampling; must be a positive integer.

rank_eval.description: Whether the RankIC model uses its rank-evaluation behavior.

seed.description: Non-negative deterministic random seed. If omitted, the service uses 2026; the three explicit LightGBM component seeds must match it.

num_threads.description: Service-fixed to one thread for deterministic runs.

feature_fraction_seed.description: Must equal seed; the service injects this value when omitted.

bagging_seed.description: Must equal seed; the service injects this value when omitted.

data_random_seed.description: Must equal seed; the service injects this value when omitted.

deterministic.description: Service-fixed to true for deterministic runs.

force_col_wise.description: Service-fixed to true for deterministic runs.

handler.description: TradeAC's approved handler, which reads bar and persisted feature fields from the configured lake. It does not compute missing indicators from this YAML.

class.description: The only data handler accepted by this workflow validator.

module_path.description: Fixed TACHandler module; do not change.

kwargs.description: Handler configuration. Unspecified fit dates default to the handler range; other omitted values receive server defaults.

instruments.description: Universe as 'all' or a comma-separated list of valid symbol names, for example 'SPY,QQQ'. Portfolio exchange codes must be a subset of this universe.

start_time.description: Inclusive first date in the handler's available-data window, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be after end_time.

end_time.description: Inclusive last date in the handler's available-data window, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be before start_time.

fit_start_time.description: Start of the model-handler fit window. Defaults to start_time and must lie within the handler range.

fit_end_time.description: End of the model-handler fit window. Defaults to end_time; it must lie within the handler range and no later than the train segment's end.

market.description: US market only; case-insensitive input is normalized to US.

label.description: Qlib label expression defining the prediction target. Choose a forward-return horizon aligned with the thesis, and do not include labels or future information as features.

feature_fields.description: Comma-separated Qlib feature field expressions, commonly prefixed with '$'. Each referenced lake field must exist for the selected market, symbols, and dates. TA/SP candidates must be computed and persisted in the lake before preflight/run if not already present. Narrative features use $narr_* fields (schema narr-v1, family=narr, ingested via tac-engine ingest_narrative_features).

infer_processors.description: Optional processor sequence applied for inference. Each processor must be one of the approved, non-configurable classes. Explicit null is also accepted and treated as omitted.

learn_processors.description: Optional processor sequence applied during learning. Each processor must be one of the approved, non-configurable classes. Explicit null is also accepted and treated as omitted.

processor.description: One approved Qlib/TAC processor. The validator ignores no custom options: kwargs, when present, must be an empty object; module_path is injected by the service for TAC processors and must not be supplied.

class.description: Approved processor class. Legacy aliases are accepted and normalized: ProcessInf→TACProcessInf, CSRankNorm→TACCSRankNorm, CSZScoreNorm→TACCSZScoreNorm, and ZScoreNorm→TACZScoreNorm.

kwargs.description: Must be empty; processor parameters are not configurable in this bounded workflow.

segments.description: Explicit, chronological, non-overlapping dataset windows. Each pair is inclusive, inside handler start_time/end_time, and later segments must begin after the previous segment ends. JSON Schema cannot compare these dates, so the fina-builder validator performs these cross-field checks.

train.description: Inclusive training [start, end] date pair. The handler fit_end_time must not extend beyond this segment's end.

valid.description: Inclusive validation [start, end] date pair, after and not overlapping the training segment.

test.description: Inclusive test [start, end] date pair, after and not overlapping validation. Optional portfolio backtest dates must remain within this segment.

dateRange.description: A two-element inclusive [start_date, end_date] calendar-date range. The start must not be after the end.

record.description: One of the approved result record types; record-specific configuration is described by the matching class.

class.description: Choose SignalRecord, SigAnaRecord, or the optional PortAnaRecord.

module_path.description: Fixed module shared by all approved record classes.

kwargs.description: Record-specific settings. Use only the properties described for the selected class.

class.description: Conditional check for the SignalRecord record variant.

kwargs.description: SignalRecord accepts no configurable keyword arguments.

class.description: Conditional check for the SigAnaRecord record variant.

kwargs.description: Optional signal-analysis settings accepted by SigAnaRecord.

class.description: Conditional check for the optional PortAnaRecord record variant.

kwargs.description: Required portfolio-analysis and backtest configuration for PortAnaRecord.

emptyKwargs.description: Must be empty for this record type.

sigAnaKwargs.description: Optional signal-analysis settings; omitted values use Qlib defaults.

ana_long_short.description: Whether to include long-short signal-analysis statistics.

ann_scaler.description: Annualization multiplier for the selected sampling frequency.

portAnaKwargs.description: Optional portfolio-analysis configuration. If included, config must define both strategy and backtest; risk_analysis_freq, when present, is fixed to 1d.

backtest.description: Portfolio backtest window and exchange settings.

risk_analysis_freq.description: Risk-analysis frequency is fixed to daily ('1d') when specified.

strategy.description: Approved TopkDropout portfolio strategy. signal must remain exactly '<PRED>' so Qlib consumes this model's predictions.

class.description: The only portfolio strategy accepted by this workflow validator.

module_path.description: Fixed module for TopkDropoutStrategy; do not change.

kwargs.description: Strategy parameters. Omitted values use validator defaults: signal '<PRED>', topk 10, n_drop 2, only_tradable true, risk_degree 0.95.

signal.description: Must be the exact model-prediction placeholder '<PRED>'.

topk.description: Number of highest-ranked instruments targeted by the strategy.

n_drop.description: Number of held instruments eligible to be dropped/replaced per rebalance.

only_tradable.description: Restrict trades to instruments the exchange considers tradable.

backtest.description: Portfolio backtest window and exchange configuration. When PortAnaRecord is used, the window must be ordered and lie inside the dataset test segment.

start_time.description: Inclusive first portfolio backtest date, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.

end_time.description: Inclusive last portfolio backtest date, formatted YYYY-MM-DD; must be on or after start_time.

account.description: Initial portfolio account value, from 1 through 1,000,000,000,000.

benchmark.description: Benchmark symbol for portfolio performance comparison.

exchange_kwargs.description: Daily exchange universe, price expression, and transaction-cost settings.

exchangeKwargs.description: Approved daily exchange settings and transaction costs. codes must be 'all' or a unique list of symbols contained in the dataset universe.

codes.description: Tradable universe: the string 'all' or an array of 1–500 unique ticker symbols, each no longer than 16 characters. A ticker list must be a subset of handler.instruments.

deal_price.description: Execution price expression is fixed to the daily close ('$close').

freq.description: Exchange frequency is fixed to daily ('day').

open_cost.description: Opening transaction cost rate, from 0 through 0.1.

close_cost.description: Closing transaction cost rate, from 0 through 0.1.

min_cost.description: Minimum currency transaction cost, from 0 through 1,000,000.
